output.one_liner: Salesforce Commerce Cloud is a cloud platform for building B2B, D2C, and B2C ecommerce experiences with shopping, inventory, and order management capabilities.

auth.notes: Client ID required for all requests. Authentication methods vary by endpoint: JWT tokens for shop customers, OAuth for Business Manager users, and Basic auth (username/password) or OAuth (client-id/client-secret) for API credentials.

evidence.snippet: A client ID is mandatory for all requests.
Authenticate the customer by obtaining a JWT to be passed in each request.
Authenticate the user by obtaining an OAuth token for a Business Manager user to be passed in each request.

access.notes: Commerce Cloud is part of the enterprise Salesforce portfolio. Pages do not explicitly state pricing model, free tier availability, or whether a sandbox/trial is available to developers.

evidence.snippet: The Open Commerce API (OCAPI) enables you to access resources using HTTP requests and HTTP responses.
Shop API: allows a client to interact with the system as a shop customer or as an agent shopping on behalf of a customer.
Use the Change Order Summary API to modify an order summary and its related entities in a single request.
It is generally available and includes the B2C CLI (@salesforce/b2c-cli), the official MCP server (@salesforce/b2c-dx-mcp, for example npx -y @salesforce/b2c-dx-mcp@latest)
An MCP server that helps connect your AI applications with Salesforce Commerce Cloud instance
Vinkius Edge enterprise Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud integration.

buildability.rationale: Public REST API with working community MCP implementations exist, but OCAPI is deprecated and access requires paid Salesforce organization with admin-level Business Manager configuration.

overview_evidence.snippet: Salesforce Commerce Cloud offers distinct solutions for B2B/D2C and B2C commerce.
Develop personalized ecommerce experiences with our fast, flexible solutions.

unknown_reasons.access: Pages do not explicitly state whether Commerce Cloud requires paid subscription, offers free tier/sandbox, trial period, or how developers can obtain credentials.
unknown_reasons.api_surface: OCAPI deprecated per page title; breadth inferred from multiple API types (Shop, Data, Meta, Order Management) but complete endpoint inventory not documented in provided pages.
unknown_reasons.mcp: Official Salesforce MCP server (@salesforce/b2c-dx-mcp) mentioned but GitHub URL not provided in pages; only package name available via npm.
